options.text: Treat the correct packing list as approval and start relabeling.
options.zh: 把正確的裝箱清單視為核准，開始重貼標籤。
options.whyZh: 裝箱清單正確不等於品管已核准更正。

options.text: Check the print history and relabel as soon as an old template is found.
options.zh: 查明列印紀錄後，一發現用過舊版型就重貼。
options.whyZh: 即使查到舊版型，重貼前仍須取得品管核准。

options.text: Relabel to match the packing list and tell quality afterward.
options.zh: 先依裝箱清單重貼，之後再通知品管。
options.whyZh: 品管核准必須在重貼之前，不是事後通知。

options.text: Have quality approve the correction even though the packing list is already right.
options.zh: 即使裝箱清單本來就正確，仍要先由品管核准更正。
options.whyZh: 清單正確可用於確認差異，但重貼前仍需由品管核准更正。

group.title: Investigating a label mismatch
group.passage:
Man: The shipping box labels show the letter R, then the number eight. The units inside show the letter R, then the number nine. I have stopped the shipment.
Woman: Keep the boxes in the marked holding area. Compare the labels with the packing list.
Man: The list is correct. The label printer may have used an old template.
Woman: Let’s check the print history. Do not relabel anything until the quality team approves the correction.
group.passageZh:
男：出貨紙箱上的標籤先顯示字母 R，再顯示數字 8。箱內產品的標示則是字母 R，接著是數字 9。我已停止出貨。
女：把紙箱留在有標示的暫存區。請比對標籤與裝箱單。
男：裝箱單沒錯。印表機可能用了舊版標籤樣板。
女：先查列印紀錄。品管部門核准更正之前，不要重貼任何標籤。
